verdict.rationale: Khoj's docs show you can share files and folders, kept in sync via the desktop app, Obsidian and Emacs. It indexes PDF, Word, markdown, org-mode, plaintext, Notion and GitHub sources, then answers chat using those files, shows the reference notes behind each response, and offers file filters plus a /notes mode that limits answers to your own notes. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that answers are well grounded, since one user reported near-random retrieval on Slovene notes and a developer said small local models handle personal-notes context poorly.
